# Partners

## The veterinary authority

The national veterinary services. They receive the hospital's yearly
report of its antimicrobial use, per species, and answer it with a
reference.

## The head office

The franchise's head office. It receives each centre's monthly activity
figures (consultations, admissions and discharges, the stays and the
housing units at midnight, new clients, the laboratory's tests and
turnaround), due by the 5th of the following month, and answers each month
with a reference.
